observations: Photo 0: a used automatic car gearbox on a dirty concrete floor, bell housing facing the camera with the torque converter or flex plate fitted, and an extra unit bolted on the left that looks like a transfer case for all-wheel drive.
Photo 1: the side of the same gearbox casing with coolant or fluid hoses, wiring connectors, a cooler on the right and a paper sticker label that is not readable.
No brand, model or transmission code is readable in either photo.
Both photos carry a dealer watermark 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS'; the setting is an open-air parts market.
The casing is dusty and oily, consistent with a used imported (tokunbo) unit; no obvious cracks in view.
No fluid condition, mileage or running evidence is shown.

identity.kind: used automatic car gearbox (transmission), apparently with all-wheel-drive transfer case
read_from: photo 0 bell housing and transfer case
photo 1 casing, label present but unreadable

claims.evidence: The label in photo 1 is unreadable and no Nissan mark or transmission code shows in either photo; fitment rests on the seller's text alone.
The unit looks used and imported, but nothing in the photos shows its origin.
A grade is not something a photo can show.
Photos 0 and 1 show a dusty, oily used gearbox on a market floor.
Internal history cannot be seen remotely; close-ups of unbroken factory seals and paint marks on the case bolts would only partly support it.
No test video, no fluid sample, no fitted drive clip.
No receipt or warranty document shown.

risks.risk: The gearbox is not the claimed Rogue or Altima unit, or is the wrong drive type (all-wheel drive versus front-wheel drive).
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the sticker label and the stamped transmission code on the casing.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced; the transmission code sets the price.

risks.risk: Internal failure such as a worn CVT belt, slipping or a failed valve body.
risks.proof: A clip of the gearbox fitted in a car shifting through drive and reverse, or a bench test clip.
risks.if_unproven: As not working, a core for rebuild.

risks.risk: Burnt or contaminated fluid showing internal wear.
risks.proof: A photo of fluid drained from the gearbox onto a white cloth.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged attachments (control unit, torque converter, transfer case, sensors, wiring).
risks.proof: A walkaround clip of all sides showing every attachment included.

proof_requests: A sharp close-up of the sticker label and stamped transmission code on the casing.
A clip of this gearbox fitted and shifting through drive and reverse, with a handwritten code and date in shot.
A photo of the gearbox fluid on a white cloth.
A walkaround clip of all sides showing the attachments.
The receipt and warranty document, if they exist.
response.reason: The photos show a used automatic gearbox, but the label is unreadable and the transmission code that sets the price is not shown, so not even a worst case price is possible until that code is photographed.
